snippet.title: Farm Ricochet - A Browser Incremental Idle RPG With RMT - Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to *Farm Ricochet,* the browser-based Idle Farming RPG where tactical hero management meets deep agricultural progression! Recruit legendary champions, manage your estate, and conquer challenging phases—directly from your web browser with instant Google sign-in.

🌾 Play instantly in your browser: https://farmricochet.com

Assemble a squad of up to five distinct heroes to gather critical resources, keep your team alive in combat, and unlock ancient structures. Whether you're actively optimizing builds or letting your farm work in the background, your progression never stops.

---

KEY FEATURES:

- *Assemble Your Dream Roster:* Collect, upgrade, and deploy heroes spanning multiple rarity tiers, from reliable Common fighters to game-breaking Mythic and Legendary powerhouses.
- *The Legacy & Ascension Systems:* Convert surplus heroes into Heroic Essence via the Legacy system. Test your luck with Ascension to push your champions' star ratings to new heights with duplicate sacrifices.
- *Dynamic Field Objectives:* Tackle varied stage goals—harvest wheat, defend the squad against waves of hazards, and activate unique production buildings for massive payout multipliers.
- *Deep Talent Trees & Gear:* Customize your party through a comprehensive Arsenal and inventory system. Unlock permanent account-wide bonuses via persistent talent trees, milestones, and achievements.
- *Rich Resource Economy:* Manage essential farm staples like Wheat, Wood, and Stone alongside Gold, Gems, and rare Heroic Essence. Open mystery chests and fill out your Creature Album as you discover rare beasts.
- *Zero Downloads Required:* Seamless web-native architecture allows you to jump in, log in with Google, and check on your team anytime, anywhere.

---

*JOIN THE COMMUNITY:*

- 💬 *Discord:* https://discord.gg/4xzvpvZmDn
- 🐦 *X (Twitter):* https://x.com/farmricochet
- 🌐 *Play Farm Ricochet:* https://farmricochet.com

If you enjoyed the trailer, make sure to *Like, Subscribe,* and leave a comment with your current squad build!

#FarmRicochet #IdleRPG #BrowserGame #IndieGame #WebGame #IncrementalGame
